claims.claim_text_normalized: The extreme foreground-background class imbalance encountered during training of dense detectors is the central cause of their lower accuracy.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We discover that the extreme foreground-background class imbalance encountered during training of dense detectors is the central cause.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The proposed Focal Loss reshapes the standard cross entropy loss to down-weight the loss assigned to well-classified examples.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We propose to address this class imbalance by reshaping the standard cross entropy loss such that it down-weights the loss assigned to well-classified examples.

claims.claim_text_normalized: RetinaNet trained with focal loss matches the speed of previous one-stage detectors while surpassing the accuracy of all existing state-of-the-art two-stage detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our results show that when trained with the focal loss, RetinaNet is able to match the speed of previous one-stage detectors while surpassing the accuracy of all existing state-of-the-art two-stage detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Focal Loss with gamma=2 yields a 2.9 AP improvement over the alpha-balanced cross entropy loss.
claims.evidence_quote_short: With gamma = 2, FL yields a 2.9 AP improvement over the alpha-balanced CE loss.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Encoding the prior probability of detecting an object in the model initialization prevents training divergence.
claims.evidence_quote_short: simply initializing the last layer of our model such that the prior probability of detecting an object is pi = .01 enables effective learning.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Focal Loss outperforms the best variants of online hard example mining by over 3 points AP.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FL outperforms the best variants of online hard example mining (OHEM) by over 3 points AP.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The exact form of the focal loss is not crucial, and other instantiations can achieve similar results.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we note that the exact form of the focal loss is not crucial, and we show other instantiations can achieve similar results.
